title: Health risk assessment of polychlorinated biphenyls in a fish species (Clarias gariepinus) from southwestern rivers, Nigeria
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,1065-1078
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00399C, Paper

I. A. Ololade, A. O. Apata, O. J. Oloyede, O. I. Akindumila, O. P. Asanga, F. F. Oloye
PCBs were found in rivers in southwestern Nigeria, with total ∑PCB concentrations significantly exceeding regulatory limits. Highly chlorinated PCB congeners dominated the profiles, and the overall carcinogenic risk exceeded acceptable levels.
